title: Canon of the Armor-Piercing Dart
summary: Teaches how to find the seams of armor and drive a hard-tipped dart through them with qi down the shaft.

title: Treatise on Qi-Borne Flight
summary: Shows a Xiantian thrower how to wrap a dart in the qi field and steer it by a thread.

title: Handbook of the Stone-Weighted Board
summary: Teaches the use of a stone-weighted board, both as a heavy-casting tool and as a close-quarters club.

title: The Long Thrower's Compendium
summary: Gathers the arts of the farthest cast, from wind layering and range bracketing to the arcing dart rain.

title: Paired Dart Rules of the Basin Throwers
summary: Sets out casting with a board in each hand, or with a partner, so two darts fly on crossing paths.

title: Hawk-Dive Cast of the Azure Sky
summary: Teaches the stooping cast from heights, where a dart falls like a hawk and strikes with doubled force.

title: Twin-Track Casting Book of the River Basin
summary: Drills two-handed casting along river banks and fords, with crossing tracks, shared loading and closing pincers.

title: Bearing-Cast Book of the Plateau Edge
summary: Teaches the holding of a bearing across open ground, casting with and against the wind and down the slope.

title: Oath of the Wind-Sworn Thrower
summary: Binds the thrower to an oath of the open stance, steady under fire, casting on the wind's own rhythm.

title: Open-Sky Cast Discipline of the Gale Hands
summary: Trains casting under open sky, riding updrafts and wind shadows and sweeping a broad front with darts.
